method: Binary floors read from the CRAN installers (Inno Setup .exe unpacked with innoextract 1.9, macOS flat .pkg unpacked in Python) and Posit's r-builds .deb/.rpm: first and last release of each build flavour, bisected to adjacent releases wherever the floor changed. Windows: EXE subsystem version plus static imports of R's own core files (R.dll, Rblas, Rlapack, Rgraphapp, Riconv, R/Rgui/Rterm/Rscript.exe), per machine (the 2.12-4.1 installers carry both i386 and x64 R). The Inno Setup MinVersion that the installer enforces is a separate rule (both must pass). macOS: highest LC_BUILD_VERSION / LC_VERSION_MIN_MACOSX minos of any Mach-O in the pkg payloads, plus the pkg Distribution volume check where the binaries predate minos load commands (R 2.x). Linux: highest GLIBC_x.y symbol, but the Posit builds are distro-locked (they link that release's ICU, libtiff, readline sonames), so each is pinned to its distro's glibc id.
filters: variant: null = CRAN builds, posit-* = Posit r-builds. file_match (regex on the download file name) separates CRAN macOS build flavours that overlap in version (R-3.1.x.pkg vs R-3.1.x-mavericks.pkg). The binary rules and the Inno Setup MinVersion rules for Windows both apply to the same .exe and both must pass.
